tools.name: demo_screening_report
tools.description: Return a real precomputed RetentionRail pre-publish screening report (a 1:00 YouTube Short) in the same shape a keyed workspace receives from get_screening_report. Sample data, not the caller's footage.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Return the signup URL, the API key URL, the install command that includes a key, and the tools a key unlocks.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_started · Private data: get_started · Public sink: demo_screening_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_started · Private data: get_started · Public sink: demo_screening_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
